verdict.rationale: Plaid is API-first for core financial data products, and Sandbox Items can be created via API instead of the Dashboard UI (plaid-docs-14), suggesting some UI/API parity. However, the docs explicitly describe Dashboard-only actions like customizing and publishing Link's flow (plaid-docs-11) and signing up for API keys (plaid-docs-10) with no corresponding API endpoint shown, and there's no OpenAPI spec or full endpoint catalog to confirm total parity (plaid-probe-3). Missing for 10: evidence that Dashboard-only settings (Link customization, key management, analytics) have API equivalents, and independent confirmation of full UI/API feature parity.
